source.sourceCategory: Category:Battle Frontier characters of the day

leadText:
Victor (Japanese: ビクター Victor) is a character of the day who appeared in Tactics Theatrics!! as the assistant to Tucker at the Battle Dome. He refereed the battle between Tucker and Ash from a mobile hovering platform.

After Ash won the battle, Victor declared him the winner and Ash found the Tactics Symbol in his .
